description.short: Dan yr Ogof — The National Showcaves Centre for Wales — is the largest show cave complex in Western Europe, set within Bannau Brycheiniog National Park. A single ticket unlocks three showcaves, a dinosaur park, a shire horse centre, an Iron Age village, and more.
description.full:
Dan yr Ogof (Welsh: 'Beneath the Cave') is a National Showcaves Centre located in the Upper Swansea Valley, within Bannau Brycheiniog (Brecon Beacons) National Park, near the village of Abercrave. The cave system — approximately 17 km of explored passages carved through Carboniferous limestone over 315 million years — is the largest show cave complex in Western Europe.

First explored in 1912 by local brothers Tommy and Jeff Morgan using candles, a coracle, and rope, the caves opened to the public in 1939. A single admission ticket grants access to ten attractions: the Dan-yr-Ogof Cave (a self-guided 2.4 km walk featuring stalactites, stalagmites, underground lakes, and waterfalls); Cathedral Cave (named for its cathedral-like chambers and 40-foot waterfalls); and Bone Cave (an ancient burial site where remains of 42 humans and numerous animals were discovered). Above ground, visitors enjoy a Dinosaur Park with 250+ life-size models, a Shire Horse Centre, Mr Morgan's Farmyard, indoor and outdoor adventure play areas, an interactive Geological Museum, a reconstructed Iron Age Village, and Millennium Stone Circles.

The cave system beyond the showcave is designated a Site of Special Scientific Interest (SSSI) and National Nature Reserve, accessible only to qualified cavers. On-site facilities include a café, gift shop, free parking, coach parking, and a Wi-Fi-enabled eco-campsite powered by hydro generators and solar panels.

Pre-booking is mandatory — all tickets must be reserved in advance at showcavesbookings.co.uk.

activities.name: Dan-yr-Ogof Cave (self-guided tour)
activities.detail: 2.4 km self-guided walk through stalactites, stalagmites, underground lakes, pools, and waterfalls. Named formations include Rasher of Bacon, Angel, Alabaster Pillar, The Nuns (five cowled stalagmites), and Cauldron Chamber (5.5 m hanging curtain).

activities.name: Cathedral Cave
activities.detail: Named for cathedral-like chambers. Features a dramatic 40-foot (12 m) underground waterfall.

activities.name: Bone Cave
activities.detail: Ancient burial site. Archaeological excavations uncovered remains of approximately 42 humans and numerous animal bones, one of the most significant prehistoric human burial deposits in Wales.

activities.name: Dinosaur Park
activities.detail: 250+ life-size dinosaur and prehistoric animal models in an outdoor park.

activities.name: Indoor and Outdoor Adventure Play Areas

accessibility.note: Some areas of the showcave may have limited accessibility. The Dinosaur Park and outdoor attractions are generally accessible. Human editor should verify the official accessibility statement on showcaves.co.uk before publishing any accessibility claims.

openingHours.pattern: Seasonal. Generally open Easter to October half-term (approximately March to November). The attraction does NOT operate every day even within season — specific open days vary week to week.
openingHours.sessionNote: Entry is by pre-booked timed sessions only. Sessions typically run from 10:30am. Closed on some weekdays (observed closure on Tuesdays and Thursdays in the sampled week of 4–10 June 2026). Do NOT publish static daily hours.
openingHours.generalSeasonPattern: April–October, 10am–3pm daily (broad guide only — actual open days vary)
openingHours.publishingRecommendation: Do not publish specific days or hours. Direct visitors to the live booking calendar at https://www.showcavesbookings.co.uk/opening-times.php to check availability before visiting.
openingHours.humanReviewNote: Opening pattern confirmed as session-based from live booking calendar sampled 2026-06-04. Calendar should be re-checked before any page refresh.

pricing.humanReviewNote: Prices were sourced from the official showcaves.co.uk plan-your-visit page and confirmed in internal events data (dan-yr-ogof-events.json, last verified 2026-02-07). pricing.pricingNote: All prices include access to all 10 attractions on site. Pre-booking mandatory. Prices subject to change — always direct users to https://www.showcavesbookings.co.uk/ for current pricing.
